हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: The Drunken Fighter is a martial arts action-drama about hidden power, redemption, and destiny. Bablu, a ridiculed drunkard handyman at a legendary Kung Fu academy, secretly possesses the strength of the mythical “Iron Head.” As enemies challenge the academy and impostors claim his glory, Bablu must decide whether to keep hiding in the shadows or rise as the true legend who can save them all.
